output_aliases.description: A list of output alias configurations for different MUAs (Mail User Agents). Each item defines the command string used by the MUA to invoke notmuch-addrlookup with the correct format flag and query placeholder.

output_aliases.items.description: Not used directly in schema validation, but defines the structure of items within output_aliases if it were a map. However, since output_aliases is a list of objects, we define the object properties below via a flat map description for the 'items' field requirement of the prompt format. Note: The prompt asks for 'items' as a FLAT map field-name -> {type, default, description} for a list-of-objects. So 'output_aliases.items' represents the schema of the objects inside the list.

output_aliases.items.name.description: A human-readable identifier for this output format (e.g., 'mutt', 'aerc').

output_aliases.items.command.description: The full command string to be executed by the MUA. It must include the '--format=<name>' flag and the query placeholder (usually '%s').
